description: Land Acquisition - Makilangamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lots A49-A53) for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations, making it primarily about land and property matters. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
